I couldn't find this in the FastAPI docs. They don't cover Flask or AWS Lambda.

For Flask on Lambda, check AWS's own documentation and the Flask deployment docs.

If you're open to FastAPI instead, the docs say you can deploy FastAPI apps to any cloud provider you choose.[1] They recommend you follow your cloud provider's guides to deploy FastAPI apps with them.[1] Another option is FastAPI Cloud, which deploys with a single command:

```console
$ uv run fastapi deploy
```
